node.statement: Every unital completely positive map T between unital C*-algebras is completely contractive: at each matrix level positivity of the 2-by-2 operator block (equivalently the Schwarz inequality T_m(z)^*T_m(z)<=T_m(z^*z)) gives ||T_m(z)||<=||z||; hence ||T||_cb<=1, while T(1)=1 gives equality. Thus Delta and Upsilon are completely contractive.
